name.meaning: Full name on the profile (for a seller, the account holder's name).

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the default billing address.

account_opened_date.meaning: Date the Northloop profile was opened.

payment_card_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the default payment card on file.

customer_type.meaning: Whether the profile buys, sells, or both.

business_name.meaning: Registered business name of a seller profile; empty for a buyer-only profile.

tax_id_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the seller's taxpayer identification number (EIN or SSN); empty for a buyer-only profile.

variant_name.meaning: FBN program the enrollment is placed in, official program name.

activated_date.meaning: Date the enrollment was approved; empty while pending.

last_review_date.meaning: Date of the most recent program review.

suspension_reason.meaning: Why inbound is suspended; none unless inbound_suspended.

exit_requested_date.meaning: Date the seller asked to leave FBN; empty unless winding_down.

units_on_hand.meaning: Units held in the network: running sum of the inventory_units account.

closed_date.meaning: Date the enrollment closed; empty while open.

fulfill_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the FBN event (the fee or reimbursement reference sellers quote).

event_date.meaning: Date the event occurred or was billed.

amount.meaning: Fee, credit or reimbursement amount, always positive; 0.00 on unit movements.

units_expected.meaning: Units declared on the inbound shipment plan.

unit_cost.meaning: Declared unit cost on the inbound shipment plan.

placement_option.meaning: Inbound split option chosen by the seller.

storage_month.meaning: Calendar month of storage being billed.

cubic_feet.meaning: Volume the fee is computed on.

adjustment_ref.meaning: Inventory adjustment reference of a warehouse loss or damage.

reimbursement_ref.meaning: Reimbursement record a found-inventory row reverses (-> fulfill_events.fulfill_event_id).

was_reimbursed.meaning: Whether found units had been reimbursed.

fee_event_ref.meaning: Fee record a credit applies to (-> fulfill_events.fulfill_event_id).

case_id.meaning: Seller case behind a reimbursement or credit (-> fulfill_cases).

removal_type.meaning: Return to the seller's address or dispose.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)
created_at.meaning: Moment the removal order was placed.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)

customer_id.meaning: The buyer who owns the membership (-> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Loop+ plan held, official plan name.

start_date.meaning: Sign-up date; the tenure start date.

trial_end_date.meaning: Last day of the free trial; empty when there was no trial.

eligibility_verified_date.meaning: Date eligibility proof was last accepted; empty when none required.

paid_through_date.meaning: Last day covered by the fees paid.

next_billing_date.meaning: Next date a fee is due.

cancel_effective_date.meaning: Date a pending cancellation takes effect; empty otherwise.

end_date.meaning: Date benefits ended; empty while benefits run.

payment_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the card charged for the fee.

promo_credit_balance.meaning: Unused promotional credit (running sum of the promo_credit account).

member_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the membership event (the charge reference).

amount.meaning: Fee, refund or credit amount, positive; 0.00 on documentary rows.

billing_period_start.meaning: First day of the billing period a charge or decline concerns.

decline_attempt.meaning: Attempt number of a declined charge (1 = original).

charge_ref.meaning: The fee charge a refund applies to (-> member_events.member_event_id).

unused_months.meaning: Whole months of the paid period not yet started when a prorated refund is computed; 0 otherwise.

usage_ref.meaning: Order number or streaming session a benefit use or credit relates to.

credit_ref.meaning: The earned credit that expired (-> member_events.member_event_id).

customer_id.meaning: The buyer who placed the order (-> customers).

variant_name.meaning: Delivery option chosen at checkout, official option name.

order_placed_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)

item_title.meaning: Listing title as shown at checkout.

sku.meaning: Seller SKU of the item ordered.

item_condition.meaning: Condition the item was sold in.

shipping_charge.meaning: Shipping charged on the order (0.00 when free).

tax_amount.meaning: Sales tax collected by Northloop on the order.

order_total.meaning: Units times unit price plus shipping plus tax.

is_gift.meaning: Whether the buyer marked the order as a gift.

promised_delivery_date.meaning: Latest delivery date promised at checkout.

shipped_date.meaning: Date of the first carrier scan; empty until shipped.

tracking_status.meaning: State of the carrier tracking uploaded for the shipment.

signature_confirmed.meaning: Whether signature confirmation was purchased for the shipment (false until shipped).

delivered_date.meaning: Date of the delivered scan; empty until delivered.

delivery_promise_met.meaning: Whether delivery was on or before the promised date; pending until delivered.

delivery_exception.meaning: Carrier exception reason; none unless undeliverable.

cancel_initiator.meaning: Who cancelled the order; none unless cancelled.

payment_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the card charged.

net_paid_amount.meaning: Net amount paid on the order: captures less refunds (running sum of the order_paid account).

closed_date.meaning: Date the order was cancelled or closed; empty while open.

order_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the order event.

amount.meaning: Money amount of the event, positive; captures add to and refunds subtract from net_paid_amount; 0.00 for documentary rows.

charge_reason.meaning: Why a capture was taken (captures only).

return_id.meaning: Return number issued at the return request; carried by scans, refunds and replacements of that return.

return_reason.meaning: Reason chosen on the return request.

return_quantity.meaning: Units covered by the return request.

return_method.meaning: How the returned item goes back.

carrier_scan_type.meaning: Which return milestone a scan records.

received_condition.meaning: Inspection result at the destination; not_inspected on a first scan.

refund_quantity.meaning: Units the item refund covers (0 for non-item components).

funded_by.meaning: Party bearing a refund or granted claim.

restocking_fee_amount.meaning: Restocking fee withheld from the item refund (0.00 when none).

return_shipping_fee_amount.meaning: Return shipping fee withheld from the item refund (0.00 when none).

late_return_deduction_amount.meaning: Late-return deduction withheld from the item refund (0.00 when none).

claim_id.meaning: Northloop Guarantee claim number; carried by the claim, its decisions and the refund it settles.

claim_decision.meaning: Decision stage of a guarantee claim.

replacement_order_id.meaning: Order number of a zero-priced replacement order.

variant_name.meaning: Payout plan held, official plan name.

verified_date.meaning: Date identity and bank verification last completed.

bank_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the bank account payouts go to.

bank_changed_date.meaning: Date the current bank account was verified after a change; empty if never changed.

balance.meaning: Total balance, reserves included; negative when the seller owes Northloop (running sum of payments_balance).

reserved_balance.meaning: Part of the balance currently reserved (running sum of reserved_funds).

negative_since_date.meaning: Date the balance most recently went below zero; empty while zero or positive.

hold_reason.meaning: Why payouts are held; none unless on_hold.

hold_start_date.meaning: Date the current hold began; empty unless on_hold.

close_requested_date.meaning: Date the seller asked to close; empty unless closing or closed.

plan_changed_date.meaning: Date the current payout plan took effect.

closed_date.meaning: Date the account closed; empty while open.

payout_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the payments ledger entry.

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry, always positive; direction comes from the event family.

order_id.meaning: Order the entry relates to (-> order_orders).

release_due_date.meaning: Date a reserve is due for release.

bank_last4.meaning: Destination account or card of a payout.

return_reason.meaning: Bank's reason for returning a payout.

fee_source.meaning: Which program billed a deducted or credited fee.

fee_event_ref.meaning: The selling or FBN fee record deducted or credited.

order_refund_ref.meaning: The buyer refund record debited (-> order_events.order_event_id).

charge_attempt.meaning: Attempt number of a negative-balance card charge.

charge_outcome.meaning: Outcome of a negative-balance card charge.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)

covered_order_id.meaning: Order of the covered item (-> order_orders).

covered_item_price.meaning: Unit price of the covered item; the aggregate limit.

coverage_start_date.meaning: First day of coverage; empty until delivered.

claims_paid_total.meaning: Settlements paid net of reversals (running sum of claim_benefits).

end_date.meaning: Date the plan expired or was fulfilled; empty otherwise.

protect_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the plan event.

admin_fee_amount.meaning: Administrative fee withheld from a cancellation refund.

unused_days.meaning: Coverage days not yet used at cancellation.

term_days.meaning: Total coverage days of the plan.

incident_date.meaning: Date the failure or accident occurred.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)

verified_date.meaning: Date verification completed; empty until verified.

store_name.meaning: Store name of a store plan; empty on the Individual plan.

billing_term.meaning: Subscription billing term; none on the Individual plan.

term_start_date.meaning: Start date of the current billing term.

term_end_date.meaning: End date of the current annual term; empty on monthly and none terms.

next_billing_date.meaning: Next date the subscription fee is billed; empty on the Individual plan.

cancel_effective_date.meaning: Date a scheduled cancellation takes effect; empty unless cancel_scheduled.

restricted_date.meaning: Date the current restriction began; empty unless restricted.

closed_date.meaning: Date the plan closed; empty while open.

selling_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the fee record (the fee reference sellers quote).

event_date.meaning: Date the fee or credit was booked.

amount.meaning: Fee billed or credit given, always positive; direction comes from the event family.

billing_period.meaning: Calendar month (or month the billing period starts) the row belongs to.

billing_term.meaning: Term a subscription fee was billed on.

listing_id.meaning: Listing number an insertion fee belongs to.

order_id.meaning: Order a final value fee or its credit belongs to (-> order_orders).

fee_category_group.meaning: Fee group of the order's item category.

standing_discount_applied.meaning: Whether the standing discount reduced this component.

fee_basis_amount.meaning: Fee basis of the order a final value fee is billed on: item subtotal plus shipping, tax excluded.

fee_event_ref.meaning: The fee record a credit applies to (-> selling_fees.selling_event_id).

gross_credit_amount.meaning: Credit before the refund administration fee.

refund_admin_fee_amount.meaning: Refund administration fee withheld from a credit (0.00 when none).

remaining_term_months.meaning: Whole committed months left when an annual term is ended early.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)

variant_name.meaning: Performance level from the latest evaluation, official level name.

last_evaluation_date.meaning: Date of the latest monthly evaluation.

next_evaluation_date.meaning: Date of the next monthly evaluation.

violation_points.meaning: Active violation points (running sum of the violation_points account).

at_risk_reason.meaning: Why the seller is at risk; none otherwise.

suspended_date.meaning: Date of the current suspension; empty unless suspended or under_appeal.

appeal_submitted_date.meaning: Date of the latest appeal against the current suspension.

reinstated_date.meaning: Date of the most recent reinstatement; empty if never reinstated.

standing_event_id.meaning: Primary id of the standing event.

order_id.meaning: Order a defect or feedback relates to (-> order_orders).

points.meaning: Violation points added, removed or expired, positive.

review_ref.meaning: Seller feedback or product review reference.

feedback_rating.meaning: Rating of removed seller feedback; not_applicable for product reviews.

dispute_id.meaning: Feedback or review dispute reference (primary id).

order_id.meaning: Order of disputed feedback (-> order_orders); empty for product reviews.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)
timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)

verification_id.meaning: Primary id of the identity-verification record (one per customer).

customer_id.meaning: Customer whose identity was checked (-> customers).

verified.meaning: Whether verification passed; once true it never reverts to false.

verified_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the most recent verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Primary id of the human-handoff record.

customer_id.meaning: Customer handed to a human representative (-> customers).

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now() (begins YYYY-MM-DD)
